title: Kingdom of Aurelia: Mystery of the Poisoned Dagger
description:
Коллекционное изданиеThis Premium Edition includes separate bonus storyline, which tells about new story and reveals the previous one in more detail. It also contains 10 additional locations, additional Hidden Object scenes and 3 mini-games, music soundtracks, screensavers and concept art from the game.

Об игреPlaying for Sam, a boy of thirteen years old, who is a friend of Princess Aurora, you get into amazing Kingdom of Aurelia, where the epoch of the Renaissance and development of technologies just have begun. You have to foil the plot directed against the royal family, find the perpetrator who poisoned the princess and rescue her. A little robot Tim and unique device which can read the thoughts of any character will help you in this.
description_short: In this steam punk adventure you have to help young Sam to save Princess Aurora and stop the villain, who intended to seize power in the Kingdom of Aurelia.
